description.value: Golden Island is a long-running Chinese restaurant that has served Salt Spring Island for over 40 years, operating as a takeout and delivery operation. The menu features house-made BBQ pork, crispy ginger beef, house-made sauces, and a range of combination meals, plus beer, wine, and ciders to go. A local institution with a loyal following, it is a practical meal stop for cyclists touring Salt Spring Island.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website clearly and repeatedly identifies this as a Salt Spring Island business ('Serving Chinese Cuisine On Salt Spring Island For Over 40 Years'), while the OSM community tag says Chemainus — the coordinates (48.8596, -123.509) align with Ganges on Salt Spring Island, not Chemainus, so the website location is authoritative. The site confirms takeout and delivery as the primary service model with no mention of dine-in, bike parking, washrooms, or cycling-specific amenities. The phone number 250-537-2535 appears on the website but is absent from OSM.
concerns: OSM community tag says 'Chemainus' but website explicitly and repeatedly identifies the business as being on Salt Spring Island; OSM coordinates (48.8596, -123.509) are consistent with Ganges, Salt Spring Island, not Chemainus — the OSM community tag appears to be an error and should be corrected.
Phone number 250-537-2535 confirmed on website but is absent from OSM tags.
No street address available in OSM or on the website.
Business appears to be takeout/delivery only with no dine-in; washroom access is unconfirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An established, actively operating takeout restaurant on Salt Spring Island — a popular cycling destination — with online ordering and a strong local reputation; useful for touring cyclists seeking a meal.
